## Change and reason

Describe the observable behavior and scope. Distinguish implemented, experimental and planned capabilities.

## Validation and acceptance

Commands, platform, results, limitations, demo attachment/link (no large videos in Git).

## Safety, licenses and rollback

- [ ] No credentials, real personal/family data, local database, cache or bundled dependency slipped into the diff.
- [ ] LICENSE/third-party attributions and SOURCE_MANIFEST are current.
- [ ] Relevant tests passed; unmet acceptance criteria are stated.
- [ ] No model permissions, publication, history rewrite or copyright transfer is implied.
- [ ] Maintainer/user approval is still required before merge or formal release.
